description: A React component class for user settings page, specifically the 'General' tab, handling user profile updates such as username, email, name, profile picture, and custom attributes.

classes.name: UserSettingsGeneralTab
classes.description: A React PureComponent class managing the user general settings tab, including profile info, email verification, profile picture, and custom attributes.
